ticket.summary: Leaking braided supply hose under bathroom sink; customer closed fixture shutoff and leak is fully stopped, but it's the home's only full bathroom - needs priority morning replacement.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed customer closed the fixture shutoff valve under the sink and leak fully stopped; keep it closed until the tech arrives [PB-01]
If the leak restarts, shut off the house main (clockwise wheel / lever perpendicular to pipe) and call us [PB-02]

quote_lines.description: Replace leaking braided supply line under bathroom sink

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Jess - booked for Tue Sep 1, 8:00 AM (SL-0901-0800), supply line replacement at $129, roughly 45 minutes. The tech will text on the way. If the leak restarts before then, close the house main [PB-02] and message us right away. Thanks for your patience tonight!
